title: Nested cosmic structures
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The Solar System is part of the Milky Way galaxy, and the Milky Way is one galaxy in the universe. These structures differ enormously in scale.

misconception: A learner may choose: Milky Way inside the Solar System
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Which arrangement correctly places our cosmic home?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Which arrangement correctly places our cosmic home? Solar System inside the Milky Way, inside the universe. The Solar System is part of the Milky Way galaxy, and the Milky Way is one galaxy in the universe. These structures differ enormously in scale.
Visual caption: Solar System → galaxy. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: Which arrangement correctly places our cosmic home?
options: Solar System inside the Milky Way, inside the universe
Milky Way inside the Solar System
The universe inside the Milky Way
recall.why: The Solar System is part of the Milky Way galaxy, and the Milky Way is one galaxy in the universe. These structures differ enormously in scale.
